items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have one that I did with Alec Wilder and one that I did with Jimmy and George Wettling

ctx.x: . . . to try to juggle that with being a performer, being a producer and entrepreneur. I think at that time you also had an early radio program that you had delved in at certain points. Am I correct?

Yes, you are correct. What I did was, during this fallow period, it seemed like other people . . . that I was not getting recorded. I felt bad about it. So having this time when I really wasn’t working all the time, I called up a guy at . . . now I can’t think of the radio station. The Pacifica station. WBAI. Chris Albertson was working there. I called up Chris and said, “I’d like to come up there and play some records, do an hour or two of jazz, because I don’t hear enough in New York.” I knew I wasn’t going to…
Yes, o.k., so that probably right now brings us up to around the mid-’70s of your career.
